rows.step: Read the @Endpoint non-code-node template end-to-end as the implementation pattern: graph-builder.ts (EdgeRelationship union, node minting, evidence variants), graph-exporter.ts, BOTH adjacency indexes (query/canonical-graph.ts + cli/mcp/graph-tools.ts), output-validator.ts, context-packer.ts, and the resource-sheet/foundation-doc frontmatter shapes (documents:, related_files:, status:).

Baseline: confirm zero doc nodes/edges in the current graph; count sheets carrying documents: frontmatter and their status values; record the resource-sheet kind-checker verdict; persist all in analysis.json (explicit before-metrics, KZ-01KYTSCY).

Design record in analysis.json: @Doc/<slug> node id shape; new `documents` EdgeRelationship (doc -> file-grain node) + evidence variant carrying frontmatter provenance (status draft|approved, placeholder_sections count, sheet path); REPO-AGNOSTIC source config (per-repo glob over coderef/resource-sheets/ + coderef/foundation-docs/, never a hardcoded fleet layout); retrieval ranking contract projected-facts > approved prose > draft, placeholders never authority; OUT of scope: standards overlay (GX-005 P2 rides this machinery later), doc-content indexing (RAG owns content).

Implement the doc-ingestion module (e.g. src/pipeline/doc-ingest.ts): parse sheet/foundation-doc frontmatter into DocNode facts + documents-edge facts; pure and deterministic; wired into the pipeline state for BOTH full-scan and --changed-files paths (incremental parity by construction through the same seam).

Teach every graph surface the new node/edge kind: graph-builder emission, graph-exporter serialization, canonical-graph adjacency, mcp/graph-tools adjacency (the TWO-indexes gotcha), and output-validator invariants for @Doc nodes and documents edges.

Surface the leverage: pack_context returns a governing-docs block for the focus element (ranked by the T3 contract, provenance fields included); orient/codebase_summary report doc-coverage; map projection exposes the centrality-ranked doc-coverage gap queue (the identify-targets logic promoted into core where every agent hits it).

Unit tests for frontmatter parsing, node/edge minting, ranking order, placeholder exclusion, and both adjacency indexes returning documents edges; then tests_for_change and the full suite green with verified counts.

After-metrics on a fresh self-scan diffed against T2: doc node/edge counts, coverage percentage, per-status breakdown; CLI/MCP parity spot-check (pack_context + one adjacency walk each side); persist diff in analysis.json.
Commit Phase 1 with the doc-coverage numbers in the body.

Hard stop: report doc-node counts, coverage queue, and readiness of the GX-005 standards overlay (P2) to the operator. NOTE: execution of this WO is sequenced AFTER the STUB-CC9094 resource-sheet program completes (operator ruling 2026-08-01) so ingestion runs against fully-keyed, checker-green sheets.
